title: Breaching Range
description: Marines with Alpha Company, Infantry Training Battalion, School of Infantry-East construct urban breaching charges as part of a culminating event of instruction on Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, N.C., Jan. 11, 2018. This exercise was held to demonstrate different demolition and explosive breaching training to develop proficiency in mobility support to infantry units. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Staff Sgt. Albert J. Carls)
